title: Finnish gift tax: same donor over three years

ask.helpsFamilyWithMoney: Do you sometimes help your children or grandchildren with money?

message: From {effectiveYear}, gifts totalling less than {limit} € from the same donor to the same recipient over a rolling {years}-year period can be exempt. At the threshold, tax applies to the combined taxable value, not just the excess.
explain: From {effectiveYear}, gifts totalling less than {limit} € from the same donor to the same recipient over a rolling {years}-year period can be exempt. At the threshold, tax applies to the combined taxable value, not just the excess. Check earlier gifts and gift dates. This is not a calendar-year allowance or a family-only exemption. Never work out the tax itself; point to the Tax Administration.
_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
